relationships.evidence_quote: The cause of reduced PV expression could be linked to DA signaling, as studies have shown that DA enhances PV expression in cortical interneurons (34, 35).

key_findings: Chronic pain (SNI) selectively impairs PV but not SOM interneurons in rostral ACC: fewer processes, lower PNN and PV expression, reduced inhibitory efficacy.
VTA dopamine fibers synapse onto PV interneurons; D1R-mediated excitation is lost in SNI and ACC DA release is reduced, linking hunger-induced analgesia to DA signaling.
